inventory_scope: Material-level native_support policy only; geometry, mesh normals/UV/tangents, pruned dependencies, transforms and runtime pipelines are not verified by this classifier.

migration.independent_readback_scope: Manifest/proof/report identities and all recorded per-file invariant gates reviewed. This audit does not rehash every changed GLB binary independently.

measurement_method.luminance: Normalized linear sRGB D65 Y derived from final opaque PNG RGB8.
measurement_method.chroma: OKLab chroma derived from final PNG; HSV retained as a secondary descriptive metric.
measurement_method.endpoint: Any final RGB8 channel equal to 255; this is not proof of where a pipeline clamp occurred.

sunlit_thatch.description: Central thatch roof; includes its texture and baked/shadowed strands.

shaded_wood.description: Central vertical wood wall below the roof; avoids window, beam, foliage and stone.

stone_wall.description: Right portion of central foundation; contains stone and mortar.

foreground_grass_soil.description: Foreground grass/soil mixture; does not isolate a single material.

foreground_fern.description: Foreground fern and a small amount of stone/ground behind its cutouts.

sapling.description: Sapling in front of left building; cutout leaves include wood/ground background.

distant_mountain.description: Left mountain face; no sky or tree geometry in the selected rectangle.

sky.description: Unobstructed upper sky; separate from geometry fog and material shading.

measurement_method.gpu_point_scope: Eight named pixels per capture at GPU frame 510; asynchronous readback, not a per-material census or exact screenshot-frame proof.
measurement_method.fixed_adaptation_scope: One older roof sample used everywhere to replace spatial and temporal history; diagnostic only.
measurement_method.argument_normalization: Only adaptation numeric spelling is canonicalized to parsed binary32 bits; raw argv remains in private evidence.

sun_report.sun_direction_policy: Recovered Sun::Update full-mode local trajectory and NiDirectionalLight column/sign; original CLMT times, compiled sun settings, identity sky-parent world rotation in this preview. Retail parent rotation, runtime mode and setting overrides unverified.
unapplied_native_inputs: G1 remaining: climate timing falls back to shipped Tamriel/SkyrimClimate when absent; local exterior sun trajectory uses compiled settings and an identity Sky parent. Retail parent rotation, active sun-setting overrides, exceptional modes, weather-transition selection and live direct-light dimmer remain unverified.
G2 remaining: additive global RGB runtime state and scalar/cube inheritance coupling remain unverified; recovered affine stage is applied with additive RGB zero.
DALC specular and final float are retained without a guessed ambient multiplier.
This pure source-preparation stage does not apply IMGS/IMAD or fog; the combined world composes recovered distance fog and optional stable IMGS afterward.

Local coefficients are supplied separately by the runtime approximation: seven closest spawned/enabled placed lights, using effective engine position/range and source RGB/FNAM. Native per-draw selection, fade offsets and local shadows remain unresolved.

observations: The local sun correction brightens the wood rectangle while foreground ground becomes darker in both automatic and fixed-adaptation pairs.
Broader qualified views alter rocks and props and raise some mixed foliage rectangles; they preserve roof, wood and sky rectangles byte-for-byte in the fixed coverage pair.
All eight selected source RGBA values are identical in both coverage-only pairs; those point samples cannot describe the changing surrounding regions.
Automatic coverage changes adaptation and affects already-qualified or unmodified regions. Holding A fixed removes that history coupling, while bloom remains scene-dependent.
Pale roof ridges, white stone patches and dark surroundings persist in both full-pack captures. The user accepted older overall brightness; that target remains unmet.
limits: Recovered local sun changes incidence and shadow production; this is a source-backed direction correction under an explicitly assumed identity Sky parent, not captured retail world rotation.
Automatic pairs include scene-dependent adaptation and bloom. Fixed pairs hold the sampled A constant but still include scene-dependent bloom.
The fixed A scalar comes from one roof sample of the older view and replaces spatial/temporal history everywhere. It is a diagnostic, not a proposed default.
Broader native view annotations are qualified legacy diffuse inputs; explicit DX10-sRGB and other exclusions remain excluded, and PBR texture transfer remains preserved.
Inventory/source qualification counts and actual applied migration counts are separate; runtime activation on every eligible draw remains unverified.
Named GPU points are not whole-material samples; asynchronous history/readback is not exact screenshot-frame proof.
The old build brightness accepted by the user is an acceptance target, not proof of all its source units or final output transfer.
No measured local or whole-frame improvement establishes retail parity or visual acceptance.
Source and migration invariant reports were reviewed and pinned; not every changed GLB was independently rehashed in this measurement audit.
Foliage rectangles include cutouts and background; large regional deltas do not identify a single material response.
The complete retail HDR-to-backbuffer pass chain remains open; this coverage correction does not select a final-output transfer mode.
Normals, unsupported material families, foliage fill, terrain lighting and mixed fallback responses remain separate gaps.
